verdict.rationale: Only indirect evidence supports this story. A community user mentions exporting and importing collections as JSON files, the docs refer to the Postman Collection format, and the Postman API lets you manage assets programmatically, which could serve as a route for extracting data. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or workspace data export, confirmation that export formats are open or standard (e.g. OpenAPI), coverage of all data types (environments, history, mocks, tests), and any independent hands-on report of migrating off Postman.
